symbol_map.rule: Only links with status 'mapped' join two symbols into one series; a series is the chain of mapped links; its id is the last symbol of the chain. Unmapped links stay separate series.

source_table: base_fo_summary (stored base), read through the research loader
membership_rule: A series is a member on session D when it belongs to the universe for D's calendar year and has a row in base_fo_summary whose known_from is D (it traded on the session before D, and that is public at D). Membership is therefore decided from data known at D. A name leaves on its real exit: the first session after its last row. Nobody is added or replaced mid-year.

U1.name: primary: all indices plus the top 100 stocks by prior-year F&O turnover
U1.indices: every index underlying (kind = index), each session it has a row as above

stocks.rank_field: sum over every session with trade_date in calendar year Y-1 of (fut_turnover + opt_turnover) in base_fo_summary, in rupees as NSE reports them (options at notional, legacy VAL_INLAKH x 1e5 or UDiFF TtlTrfVal), summed across every symbol of the series
stocks.eligible: kind = stock, at least one row with trade_date in Y-1
stocks.tie_break: equal turnover: series id in ascending alphabetical order
stocks.cutoff: rank <= 100 (exactly 100 when at least 100 are eligible)
stocks.rebalance: once a year, effective from the first session of year Y
stocks.note: 2010 has no prior year in the base, so U1 (stocks and indices) starts in 2011

U2.name: robustness: every underlying in the stored base
U2.members: every series of kind stock or index (INDIAVIX futures, kind other, have no options and are excluded), each session it has a row as above

protected_range.rule: Ranking a year whose inputs lie in the final holdout runs inside a sealed function: its only output is the member lists with membership dates; it never prints, stores, logs or returns turnover, ranks or rank gaps, and its errors carry no values. Each run is a data build in the trial log.
protected_range.open_rankings: 2011-2025 membership (inputs 2010-2024): turnover and rank gaps may be reported
protected_range.end: membership is built through 2026-10-26, the last day of the final holdout; the forward holdout (from 2026-10-27) is not read

changes: Any change to these rules after results have been seen is a new version of this file and is logged as a trial.
